capital_loss_deduction_limit.description: Net capital losses first offset capital gains. Any remaining net loss can offset up to $3,000 of ordinary income per year ($1,500 if married filing separately); the rest carries forward to future years.
capital_loss_deduction_limit.source: 26 U.S.C. § 1211(b) and § 1212; IRS Topic No. 409, Capital Gains and Losses

holding_period.description: The holding period begins the day after acquisition; a sale exactly one year after purchase is still short-term. Long-term gains get the 0% / 15% / 20% rates; short-term gains are taxed as ordinary income.
holding_period.source: IRS Topic No. 409, Capital Gains and Losses

net_investment_income_tax.description: Additional 3.8% tax on the lesser of (a) net investment income or (b) the amount by which modified adjusted gross income exceeds the threshold. The CryptoTaxAI estimator applies it against total income (other income + gain) as an approximation of MAGI.
net_investment_income_tax.source: 26 U.S.C. § 1411 (statutory, not inflation-adjusted); IRS, Questions and Answers on the Net Investment Income Tax

note: Other federal parameters the CryptoTaxAI calculators apply, with their legal sources. Amounts marked 'statutory' are set by the Internal Revenue Code and are NOT adjusted for inflation.
